listing.title: Eco-Friendly Wellness Hamper: Tote Bag, Tea, Candles & More
listing.body_text:
Treat yourself or a loved one to a thoughtful blend of sustainability, style, and relaxation with this eco-friendly hamper. Curated with care, it includes high-quality, eco-conscious items designed to delight while supporting a greener lifestyle.
What’s inside?
Reusable Off-white Cotton Tote Bag: Stylish, durable, and spacious, this cotton canvas tote is perfect for errands, beach trips, or everyday use. Bag size: 18 x 16 inches, expandable up to 4.5 inches. Strap: 12 inches.
500 ml Stainless Steel Bottle: Stay hydrated sustainably with this strong, eco-friendly bottle, resistant to wear and tear. Dimensions: Height – 18 cm, Diameter – 7 cm.
Coconut Shell Candles: Handcrafted from upcycled coconut shells filled with organic soy wax, these candles create a warm glow and subtle, relaxing fragrance.
Daily Journal SOS Notebook: Minimalist A5 notebook (64 pages, 210 mm x 140 mm) made from recycled paper, perfect for journaling, sketching, or planning.
Assorted Herbal Tea Box: Enjoy a selection of organic teas for wellness and taste:

•
Organic Green Tea – refreshing and antioxidant-rich

•
Organic Blue Tea – calming and soothing

•
Organic Peach Blue Tea – fruity and delightful

•
Organic Hojicha Tea – smoky and flavorful

Premium Handmade Eco Playing Cards: 52 beautifully illustrated cards featuring quotes from environmental leaders, combining fun with mindful learning.
All items come in a green gift box that can be reused or recycled, making this hamper a perfect gift for eco-conscious friends, family, or colleagues. Thoughtful, sustainable, and stylish – this hamper offers a guilt-free experience that’s as kind to the planet as it is to the recipient.
